releases.author: Dr3pi
releases.description:
## Manuscript Export 0.2.0 — Longform support

**New: one-command export of [Longform](https://github.com/kevboh/longform) projects.** Run **"Export Longform project to EPUB"** and your scenes export in your Longform order (not filename order), with the project's title as the book title. Multiple projects in one vault get a picker; single-file Longform projects are split into chapters on `#` headings.

**Fixed:** YAML frontmatter in chapter notes was leaking into the exported book — the `---` fences rendered as scene breaks and the metadata as prose. Both export commands now strip frontmatter properly.

The original folder-based command ("Export manuscript to EPUB") is unchanged: one note per chapter, natural-sort order.
